Once upon a time:
, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there was a small house. In the house, a boy named Tom lived with his mom and dad. They were a happy family.
One day, Tom went outside to play. He saw a big rock and decided to lift it. When he lifted the rock, he found a hidden door under it. Tom was very surprised. He called his mom and dad to show them the door.
Tom's mom and dad opened the door and went inside. They found a big room with lots of chairs. They sat down and felt dizzy. They closed their eyes and waited. Suddenly, the room started to shake. The chairs fell down and broke into many pieces. The pieces went everywhere. Tom, his mom, and his dad were very sad because the room was broken. They had to leave the room and find a new place to live.

, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to play with her ball in the park. One day, she saw a man playing a new game with a pitch. The man was very good at the game and all the kids wanted to be like him.
Lucy thought the man was great. She wanted to be like him. She walked up to the man and said, "I want to play the game too!" The man looked at her and said, "Okay, but only if you are very good." Lucy was so happy and played the game with the man.
As they played, Lucy tried her best to be great like the man. She helped her friends and shared her toys with them. The man was very happy with Lucy's change. In the end, everyone at the park had a great time playing the game on the pitch. The moral of the story is that being good and helping others can make you feel like you are great too.
